description: The words Part 5's validators keep out of a line a student reads, for a reader that applies the same test without importing Part 5. Generated by scripts/make_student_words.py from the lists named in sources; never edit by hand.
match: Compare case-insensitively, on the line lower-cased, word-bounded (\b before and after). A banned entry that ends in * matches any word that starts with the entry before the *; an entry without * is a whole word (the validator has none today). A praise entry is a phrase of whole words, written with single spaces, that matches when its words are joined by any run of whitespace or hyphens (nice-effort, nice  effort). Zero-width characters (ignored_characters) are ignored: read the line twice, once with each one removed and once with each one replaced by a space, and refuse it when either reading matches. A fault line also has the typographic apostrophe read as a straight one before the test. A line that matches an entry is refused where applies_to says the list is tested.

applies_to.banned: the notes and observations of the second opinion (part5/opinion/guard.py); a fault line is not tested against it
applies_to.praise: every fault line a model writes, timed or not, and the notes and observations of the second opinion (part5/phrasing/template.py, part5/opinion/guard.py)
